decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the established construction range, and with industry growth and no signs of underperformance there is no shortfall against aspiration to trigger problemistic search.
The articulated dumper draws on existing engineering and service capabilities, and two years is too short to judge it below aspiration, so the firm's slack lets it continue.
The mine rescue vehicle is a distant niche product with uncertain results, but it uses the firm's underground expertise, and slack from growth, hiring and own R&D allows the firm to keep carrying it.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line is a substantial commitment adjacent to the firm's core lifting equipment and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
The material lift line is described as the most popular in the rental market and has just won a large order, so it clearly meets or exceeds aspiration.
Although distant from the core offer, the mining loader logged 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which is positive field evidence above aspiration that supports keeping it.
